2025-07-20.riddle: I send your voice across the air, I keep you talking from anywhere. I ring and buzz inside your hand— What am I?
2025-07-20.hint: You probably check me too often.

2025-07-21.riddle: I climb with rungs, I never bend, I help you reach where arms won’t extend. Just lean me right and up you go— What am I?
2025-07-21.hint: I take you higher without stairs.

2025-07-22.riddle: You see me move but I stay in place, I chase the wind in every race. My blades go round to cool the air—indoors or out, I’m always there. What am I?
2025-07-22.hint: I spin and cool, but never travel.

2025-07-23.riddle: I march in lines but never walk, I'm full of thoughts yet never talk. I live inside your spiral spine and help your notes all stay in line.
2025-07-23.hint: You bring me to class and fill me with writing.

2025-07-24.riddle: I spin and swirl in painted jars, I color nails or tiny stars. With brush so small, I glide with grace—on fingertips, I find my place. What am I?
2025-07-24.hint: I'm used to decorate nails, often with color and shine.

2025-07-25.riddle: I hold your ideas in digital form, typed with keys so quick and warm. With clicks and clacks, I take your thought and save it. What am I?
2025-07-25.hint: You use me to type essays, search the web, or play games.

2025-07-26.riddle: I’m soft and round, you toss me high, across the net, I sail and fly. I'm used in games where players leap and hit by hand. What am I?
2025-07-26.hint: You spike me over a net in the sand or gym.

2025-07-27.riddle: I tick without a sound, I spin but stay in place. I help you cook things just on time, with patience, poise, and grace. What am I?
2025-07-27.hint: You twist me to count down when you’re baking or boiling.

2025-07-28.riddle: I’m folded tight and sealed with care, I fly the world through open air. I hold a card or maybe cash—delivered quick or in a flash. What am I?
2025-07-28.hint: I carry messages and am opened with a tear.
